title: Give, Bring, Put
label: ch:mr-request-verbs
canDo: I can ask for four everyday actions in Marathi -- give, drink, bring, put -- and name the Indo-European root under each.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R22-request-verbs and ask, unaided, for water to be given, tea to be brought, and milk to be put down, each with the polite kripaya frame.
